findings.highlight: I brush my body against hers without the slightest hint of reservation
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は、遠慮せず彼女に全身でぶつかり
findings.explanation: Haruki crashes bodily into Mari without holding back as he catches and embraces her. 'Brush my body against hers' makes the impact gentle and sexually suggestive, changing the force and urgency of the reunion.
findings.japanese:
俺は、遠慮せず彼女に全身でぶつかり、
思いっきり抱きしめてその身体を包み込んだ。
findings.todokanai: I brush my body against hers without the slightest hint of reservation, embracing her body with all the strength I can muster.

findings.highlight: this isn't supposed to be the place you should've come for me!
findings.evidenceJa: 本当は…突っ込みどころはそこじゃないのに！
findings.explanation: Mari catches herself and says that Haruki's extraordinary journey is not actually the point she should be challenging him on—the real issue is what his arrival means emotionally. The translation instead says New York is the wrong place for him to come for her, contradicting her embrace and obscuring the self-aware comic pivot.
findings.japanese:
「意味、わからないよ…っ、
どうしてお前、こんなところまで私を追って…
ほ、本当は…突っ込みどころはそこじゃないのに！」
findings.todokanai: "I don't get you at all… why did you chase after me to a place like this…? T-This… this isn't supposed to be the place you should've come for me!"

findings.highlight: I had them sorted out on the day I fell out with Mari-san
findings.evidenceJa: 麻理さんと決裂したあの日から
findings.explanation: Haruki began arranging the visa and other procedures from the day he and Mari broke apart. The translation says every procedure was already completed on that day, converting the start of a sustained contingency plan into implausible instant completion.
findings.japanese:
査証やその他の手続きは、
麻理さんと決裂したあの日から…
findings.todokanai: As for the visa and the rest of the necessary procedures, I had them sorted out on the day I fell out with Mari-san…

findings.highlight: I couldn't see it being the end of our relationship. But I had yet to convey to her that we had to see each other.
findings.evidenceJa: その時、二人の関係に出口は見えなかったけれど、それでも、絶対に会わなくちゃいけないって、それだけは譲れなかったから。
findings.explanation: At that point Haruki could see no way out or resolution for their relationship, but one conviction was nonnegotiable: he absolutely had to meet her. The translation nearly reverses the first clause into not seeing the relationship's end, then changes his settled determination into information he had not yet conveyed.
findings.japanese:
その時、二人の関係に出口は見えなかったけれど、
それでも、絶対に会わなくちゃいけないって、
それだけは譲れなかったから。
findings.todokanai: At that time, I couldn't see it being the end of our relationship. But I had yet to convey to her that we had to see each other.

findings.evidenceJa: しかも自分で原稿を持ち込んで
findings.explanation: Mari's deadline-extending maneuver involves personally carrying the manuscript into the printing company after negotiating with its president. The translation has her buying the manuscript, an unrelated act that makes the publishing workflow nonsensical.
findings.japanese:
例えば、直接印刷所の社長と交渉して、
しかも自分で原稿を持ち込んで、
デッドラインからさらに数時間延ばすという荒業。
findings.todokanai: …Like negotiating with the president of the printing company, buying the manuscript herself, and extending the deadline for several more hours.

findings.highlight: just how many days in succession did we stay up all night, laughing and talking afterward
findings.evidenceJa: その他にも方法はいくらでもあるって、何日か続いた徹夜の後、笑いながら言ってたっけ
findings.explanation: After several consecutive all-nighters, Mari laughed and told Haruki there were any number of other ways to extend a 'real deadline.' The translation turns this recollection into a question about how many nights 'we' stayed up laughing, deleting the actual lesson that Haruki is now applying.
findings.japanese:
その他にも方法はいくらでもあるって、
何日か続いた徹夜の後、笑いながら言ってたっけ…
findings.todokanai: In addition to all the other things there, just how many days in succession did we stay up all night, laughing and talking afterward…?

findings.evidenceJa: 麻理さんの所有物に、なったんだ
findings.explanation: Haruki jokingly concludes that Mari has branded him a useless, cowardly, carefree kept man and made him her property. 'Everything to Mari-san' sentimentalizes the ownership punchline into a grand declaration of emotional importance.
findings.japanese: 麻理さんの所有物に、なったんだ…
